question: The bile produced by the liver is stored in the gallbladder from where it is secreted into the duodenum when the muscles involved receive this order in the form of hormonal and nervous signals mediated by:
analysis: The bile produced by the liver is stored in the gallbladder and released into the duodenum in response to hormonal and nervous signals. Cholecystokinin is the hormone responsible for stimulating the gallbladder to contract and release bile. Parasympathetic activation also plays a role in this process.
